patch.summary: Twilio cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Twilio pricing is plan-gated across 6 researched tiers. Free entry: Free trial. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: Twilio cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Twilio against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free trial until a gated capability (AI assistance (Free trial, SMS / MMS, Voice APIs, Flex Named User, Flex Active User Hour, Enterprise / volume discounts)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (cloud phone, call routing, call recording) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Not an SMB softphone / UCaaS product — requires engineering to ship a phone experience. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Product and engineering teams embedding voice, SMS or WhatsApp into their own apps requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Not an SMB softphone / UCaaS product — requires engineering to ship a phone experience
Side-by-side cost with RingCentral on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Not an SMB softphone / UCaaS product — requires engineering to ship a phone experience

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Usage + carrier fees make TCO hard to forecast versus flat seat phones

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Shared inbox / agent UX only appears if you build it or buy Flex

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: AI (Conversation Intelligence, Flex Copilot) is usage/add-on priced

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Compliance (A2P 10DLC, short codes) adds onboarding fees and lead time

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Twilio on identical constraints.
